integrity: The proof is reconstructed in full, the relevant cyclic-quotient criteria are attributed to primary sources, exact arithmetic is replayed independently by the bundled checker, and no independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to the two-heavy weighted-projective family; the finite checker is a regression test rather than the all-dimensional proof. The invariant is explicitly a minimum of local Reid–Tai ages, without asserting equivalence to every global minimal-log-discrepancy normalization.
title: A sharp Reid–Tai terminality margin for two-heavy weighted projective spaces
